bagPolicy.summary: At SoFi Stadium, permitted bags must be clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC and not exceed 12" x 6" x 12". Small non-clear bags up to 4.5" x 6.5" are also allowed.
allowed: clear plastic bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
small clutch bags up to 4.5" x 6.5"
prohibited: purses larger than a clutch bag
bagPolicy.note: Bag policy may vary per event. Medical bags are not specifically mentioned.

parking.note: Parking passes must be purchased in advance to avoid higher fees on event day. Onsite parking is limited for NFL games, with alternative options like Park and Ride available. For concerts and non-NFL games, parking lots open 3 to 4 hours before the event.

rideshare.note: Drop-off is on the northbound curb of Kareem Court. Drivers approach via westbound Pincay Drive from Crenshaw Boulevard. Pickup is at Kareem Court and Manchester Boulevard.

concessions.note: SoFi Stadium offers a diverse range of food and drink options, featuring local flavors and popular favorites. Visitors can enjoy gourmet burgers, craft beers, and a variety of international cuisines. Special offerings include vegan and vegetarian options to cater to different dietary preferences.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: At designated events, free wheelchair escorts are available at any entry point; ask the nearest Guest Experience Representative when you arrive. Escorts take you between the entry gates and your seat, but staff and the wheelchair don't stay with you during the event.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is prohibited without approval. For an emergency, speak to a Guest Experience Representative or Security Supervisor before leaving. Approved re-entry uses the same gate.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Your Ticketmaster ticket is in the SoFi Stadium app, the Ticketmaster app, or Ticketmaster.com. Add it to your mobile wallet before you arrive and have it ready to scan. To pick up Will Call, bring a valid photo ID and, for online orders, the card used to buy.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For concerts and non-NFL events, entry gates open 1 to 2 hours before the start time and parking lots open 3 to 4 hours before. For NFL games, entry gates open 2 to 3 hours before kickoff. Check your event page for exact times.
